description: This file contains a PHP class named Filter within the Opencart\Admin\Model\Catalog namespace. It manages CRUD operations and retrieval functions for product filters, including descriptions and filtering parameters, in an OpenCart admin module.
external_files: db prefixes and configuration dependencies (implied external database and config methods)

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A PHP class handling CRUD operations and retrieval of filter data within the OpenCart admin catalog module.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Inserts a new filter record into the database, adds its descriptions for multiple languages, clears cache, and returns the new filter ID.

methods.name: editFilter
methods.description: Updates an existing filter record, replaces descriptions, clears cache.

methods.name: deleteFilter
methods.description: Deletes a filter and its descriptions from the database, and clears cache.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific filter by its ID.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Fetches a list of filters with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalFilters
methods.description: Returns the total count of filters in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a filter in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a specific filter ID.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all filter descriptions in a given language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions for a filter grouped by language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all filter descriptions in a specific language.
